title: A domain decomposition online-learning-enhanced nonlinear elimination preconditioner
summary: Nonlinearly preconditioned inexact Newton methods form an effective class of solvers for large-scale nonlinear algebraic systems arising from the discretization of partial differential equations. A central challenge in nonlinear elimination (NE) preconditioning is the reliable identification of the slowly converging components to be eliminated.
